recap.title: Whitlock’s stoppage-time leveller earns Harlow Cross a 2-2 draw
recap.summary: Harlow Cross salvaged a 2-2 draw with a 90+1' leveller after Marsh Dock United had looked set to take all three points. 15' — Bellweather wasted a huge opening, firing an off-target 0.76 xG chance from 11.0 m at 104 km/h that left the score 0-0 and let Marsh Dock United regroup. 45+2' — Rookwood struck before halftime and flipped the match, turning a 51% home edge into 19% and lifting Marsh Dock United from 14% to 52% as they went into the break ahead. 90+1' — Whitlock levelled at 90+1', swinging Harlow Cross’s win chance from 0% to 8%, sending the draw probability to 89% and cutting Marsh Dock United’s chance to 2%. Bellweather stood out with a 9.2 rating, producing the early 0.76 xG opportunity and later setting up Okonkwo-Reid’s 66' goal. The numbers tell the rest: Harlow Cross finished with 2.43 xG, 16 shots and 63% possession while Marsh Dock United had 0.73 xG, 9 shots and 37% possession, and the game ended 2-2 (wp_draw 100%).
